source_passage: In our opinion, this submission proves that a relativistic quantum field theory satisfying the Wightman axioms can be constructed as a scaling limit of four-dimensional Wilson lattice gauge theory for any simple compact gauge group. It does not prove that the infinite-volume limit is unique or that there is a mass gap.
claim: The October 2026 submission proves that Yang-Mills theory exists for SO(8) lattice gauge theory via scaling limit construction.
label: established
reference_rationale: SO(8) is a simple compact gauge group, covered by 'any simple compact gauge group' in the assessment.
